summary.text: Amanda Cook is a Democratic member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 60 in Guilford County since her appointment in November 2025 and is seeking election to the seat in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The General Assembly lists her as founder of The Teacher's Edge.

paragraphs.text: Amanda Cook earned a bachelor's degree from the University of North Carolina at Greensboro in 2008 and a graduate degree from Gardner-Webb University in 2021, according to Ballotpedia.
The Guilford County Democratic Party appointed Cook to North Carolina House District 60 on November 15, 2025, to replace Cecil Brockman (D), and she assumed office on November 18, 2025.
Ballotpedia reports that Cook advanced from the Democratic primary on March 3, 2026.
